test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Indian Olympian is associated with golf?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aditi Ashok.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aditi Ashok **is an **Indian trained golf player from Bangalore**. 
 
• Aditi Ashok plays on the **Ladies European Tour and LPGA Tour**. 
 
• She made her Olympic **Games beginning at the 2016 Summer Olympics.**
 
• She certified for the **2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo,** play for India in golf, and finished 4th.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhinav Apjit Bindra **is an **Indian Olympic gold medalist, ex sports shooter, and business tycoon.** 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an **Indian track and field player who is the rekindled Olympic champion and world championship silver medalist in the javelin throw.** 
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** is an **Indian freestyle wrestler **who** achieved a silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics **in the** category of 57 kg **.
